description: The working context of one rikma, cut around what the user is about to do - call it before any piece of work in a rikma, coding or not. Always returns: who the rikma is (description, values, links, members, roles, its consent clock), and "the world now" (what waits for the user there, what is new, how busy it is). Plus ONE focus, the most specific you can name: leadId (preparing a meeting with a customer: the lead, their log, what they wanted and today's prices - no phone/email), roleId (working in a role: who holds it, its missions), processId (a thread the rikma is pursuing), actId (a task: same as getTaskContextTool, plus its role), missionId, productId (with delivery), or topic (free text, searched across the rikma). Every list is a summary; `more` names the tool and arguments for the full version. Members only. Read-only. Docs: https://1lev1.com/mcp#getRikmaContextTool

actId.description: A task (act) of this rikma, from listMyTasksTool.

leadId.description: A lead of this rikma, from listRikmaLeadsTool.

missionId.description: A mission in progress of this rikma.

processId.description: A process of this rikma, from listRikmaProcessesTool.

productId.description: A product of this rikma, from listRikmaProductsTool.

roleId.description: A role (tafkid) id of this rikma.

topic.description: Free text when no id fits, e.g. "refund policy" or "mobile checkout".

name: getRikmaContextTool
